name: Amazon Nova Act
description: Builds and runs browser UI-automation agents from natural-language act() steps and Python, with human-in-the-loop handoff and deployment to AWS, for teams automating web workflows.

skills.name: Natural-Language Browser Steps
skills.description: Executes act() calls that observe the page and take browser actions in an agentic loop.

skills.name: Information Extraction
skills.description: Extracts structured data from web pages into typed results.

skills.name: Human-in-the-Loop
skills.description: Escalates steps to a human supervisor when a workflow needs approval or input.

skills.name: Parallel Sessions
skills.description: Runs multiple browser sessions in parallel within one workflow run.

skills.name: Workflow Deployment
skills.description: Deploys Python workflows to AWS AgentCore Runtime with the Nova Act CLI.
